message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSV/TXT files via filedialog and passes them directly into pandas DataFrames with no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data acquisition is done through local file dialogs; there is no remote source fetching, so no checksum verification or authentication is implemented or needed, but the control is absent.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing page offers scaling, encoding, and dropping features/subjects, but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are present anywhere in the visible pipeline stages.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the provided snippets checks class balance, expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor defense, trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the provided code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any of the provided code snippets.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the provided code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code is a GUI data exploration/preprocessing application with no evaluation pipeline, held-out test set isolation, hashing of evaluation data, or multiple independent metric checks.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads CSV/TXT files and passes data directly to preprocessing and analysis pages without any shape, range, type, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: No output bounds checking, NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation are visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; the application performs tabular data analysis (clustering, classification, regression), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
